name: Lamb Shawarma
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1.5 kg leg of lamb or other tender cut

steps: Cut the lamb into large 4 cm chunks.
Combine the nutmeg, cinnamon, cardamom, garlic cloves, black pepper, cayenne pepper, lemon, and vinegar in a small mixing bowl and pour over meat.
Grill the onions with some garlic for few minutes.
Drain meat, pat dry, and grill until golden brown.
Serve with pita bread, tomato, fresh onion, tabbouleh, tzatziki, lettuce and chili sauce.
